text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One day, I get an idea to address<n>Biwa Hayahide's
anxiety by setting<n>up a scrimmage between her and
Winning Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide loses, but her loss<n>facilitates a
major breakthrough. She<n>realizes she started
creating her<n>equation because of a desire not to<n>lose
to her sister, Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Success, though, isn't just about notlosing. It's about winning. So weresolve to create a real winningequation from scratch... hopefully intime for the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket and Narita Taishin give<n>their full
support.
